steps.content: The successive deaths of her little spiders leave the girl furious. In the darkness, a single spider paces back and forth on agitated legs, even angrily shooting silk at innocent insects in the corners to vent her frustration.

steps.speaker: Spider Number Six
steps.content: Did I forget to check the fortune before stepping out yesterday? What's with this god-awful luck? Is this damn manor personally cursed to spite me?!

steps.speaker: Spider Number Six
steps.content: Crazy ones! Dead ones! Sly foxes! Filthy beasts! And a big cat who thinks spiders are playthings! Not a single decent "host" to be found! Haven't even caught a whiff of that codex, and my precious darlings are nearly all dead!
She rants irritably at the empty air, mentally marking each guest in the manor with a blood-red X. Finally, the faces of those first two pathetically weak targets reluctantly surface in her mind.

steps.speaker: Spider Number Six
steps.content: Fine! Fine! No choice left, is there? This granny will swallow her pride and go back to those two scrawny beanpoles! Weak as dishwater, but... better than nothing, I suppose!
She's just gathering herself to hunt for her next target when muffled sounds erupt from the silence: the thud of a struggle, the rasp of something being dragged.

steps.speaker: Spider Number Six
steps.content: Now what?! Is there no end to this?! Who's so blind they'd pick this moment to make trouble when Granny's already fit to burst?!
Rage burning within her, she resolves to investigate. She will sacrifice this body if it means making whoever dared to cross her pay.
Huffing with indignation, the little spider crawls and swings through her webs, racing toward the sound. As she rounds the corridor corner, a chilling scene fills its compound eyes—

steps.speaker: Spider Number Six
steps.content: That's... one of last night's beanpoles?!

The beanpole she just mentioned is being dragged into the darkness. A shadowy figure has a hand clamped firmly over her mouth and nose. She realizes in a flash: this beanpole is with that little one in gray!

steps.speaker: Spider Number Six
steps.content: Oh no, no, no! If one's in trouble, the other's in danger too! Where's that little one? Still kicking around?!
The little spider abandons all stealth, changes direction, and scurries toward the guest room at top speed.
Splat—
The legendary drift master barely rounds the corner, preparing for her grand entrance, when an elegant, thick-soled cotton boot slams down upon her.

steps.speaker: Spider Number Seven
steps.content: Heh... Good. Real good. You think this granny doesn't keep spares?

Having already lost so many of her tiny soldiers, she has wisely pre-positioned several backup units inside. The instant Number Six's world goes dark, her consciousness seamlessly links with another. In that same moment, Number Seven activates and takes over without hesitation.

After a lightning-fast crawl, Number Seven slides into position at the guest room entrance. It is now deserted, marked only by scattered drops of blood and Number Six's crushed remains lying in an inconspicuous corner.

She squeezes through the crack in the door and surveys her new domain. The room is empty save for the little one in gray on the bed. With a pale face, the kid seems to be anxiously awaiting the other companion's return, completely unaware of her presence.

steps.speaker: Spider Number Seven
steps.content: Can you even take it, little one? Look at you, paler than a ghost, weaker than last time. You're not gonna croak the moment this granny moves in, are you? How embarrassing that'd be.
The little spider approaches her target, studying the person intently; only once she has confirmed the target is unharmed does she feel at ease.

steps.speaker: Spider Number Seven
steps.content: Ahh, so that's it. Still got some poison clinging to you, poor little one. Neutralized, but your internal energy's a wreck... No wonder you look like yesterday's laundry.

steps.speaker: Spider Number Seven
steps.content: Well. No choice now. Don't blame this old granny. If you want someone to blame, blame the rest of this manor for being utterly useless...

steps.speaker: Spider Number Seven
steps.content: Is this what they call "kicking someone while they're down"? Heheheheh...
With no time to feel even a trace of shame for striking when her target is down, the little spider scrambles onto the bed and zeroes in on the exposed section of wrist—
[Release the shackles]
Clang!
A blinding red light erupts from the person's hand, cutting through the darkness and locking the little spider's body in place.

Her fangs do not meet the expected yield of flesh and blood. Instead, they bite down on what feels like thorn-covered brambles. An indescribable, strange power, thick with an imprisoning force, surges violently through them and into the little spider's form!
It violently repels the spider's intrusion, its vicious energy burning back through their mental link and searing the consciousness of the girl who controls the creature.

steps.speaker: Spider Number Seven
steps.content: What in the—?! What is this thing?!
The sudden flash of light startles the target, giving the little spider the chance to hide inside the person's clothing and wait for the next opportunity to strike...
